posts.text:
Manuel Ugarte to Madrid. HERE WE GO!


Fabrizio Romano (@FabrizioRomano)

🚨 Florentino Pérez: “The €150m deal is NOT for a defender. It could be midfielder or forward”.





— https://nitter.net/FabrizioRomano/status/2062651237938438544#m
Same energy as ‘Manchester United are seriously looking at Elliot Anderson (but will end up with Ederson and some dude in eredivisie you don’t know exists yet)

The Rogan to 60 thing feels like what someone puts out when they want you to think they actually can get Rogan but then in 3 months it’s Coleman Hughes interviewing Bret Weinstein about the woke mind virus.

Really is true that the only thing that could fuck up the Knicks right now is Trump showing up for game 3. I would say the boos will be deafening but tickets cost 5000 dollars…


Stew Irvin (@Stewdio)

Knicks 2-0, lose in 6 after a visit from the Orange Reaper



— https://nitter.net/Stewdio/status/2062372387119607870#m

It would be cool if a guy who everyone says is a good person got over. He looks at peace here.


The Sporting News (@sportingnews)

Karl-Anthony Towns said he felt a calming presence ahead of Game 1.

"I felt like a kid. ... In a way I felt like I was seeing (my mom) in the stands and it was fun. It was really comforting."

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/sportingnews/status/2062380468402610675#m
Kings firing Mike Brown Jesus Christ man if there ever was a ‘I’ve been kicked out of better bars than this…’ so fucking bleak
KAT probably second best defensive player in these playoffs
Knicks defense in the fourth was so good. Wemby looked lost and hart was everywhere.
Every time Wemby takes a 3 where I go ‘that’s a shot you take when you’re tired’ it goes in
Someone needs to tell Brunson to not shoot his team out of this 4th quarter
Sorry to glaze so much but I just can’t get over what he’s doing. He’s 20 and in the finals doing this and there are entire parts of his game that don’t exist yet.

Comp for Harper is so hard. Part Brandon Roy patience and smoothness, strength of… ron artest? Finishes at the rim through defenders like Luka. Once he adds in a reliable easy 18 footer and a floater it’s over. What are we watching.
